description: This file contains library code and utility functions for testing and managing a Perforce (p4) server integration with Git. It includes setup and teardown routines, environment configuration, process control, and auxiliary functions related to p4d server lifecycle, client setup, and test environment management.

methods.name: native_path
methods.description: Converts a given path to Windows format on Cygwin or resolves real path on other systems, used for handling paths in a cross-platform manner.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts a Perforce p4d server instance, ensuring it's properly initialized and ready, setting environment variables, and creating necessary client configurations.

methods.name: p4_add_user
methods.description: Creates a new Perforce user with specified name and optional full name.

methods.name: p4_add_job
methods.description: Creates a new job in Perforce with specified ID, marking it as open and setting user to dummy.

methods.name: retry_until_success
methods.description: Retries a command until it succeeds or timeout is reached, used for robust environment setup.

methods.name: stop_and_cleanup_p4d
methods.description: Terminates the p4d server process and cleans up its database and PID files.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Removes and recreates the git directory used for testing.

methods.name: marshal_dump
methods.description: Uses Python marshal to extract a specific field (symbol) from marshaled data read from stdin.

methods.name: client_view
methods.description: Creates a Perforce client specification with a given view mapping.

methods.name: is_cli_file_writeable
methods.description: Checks if a file is writable, with special handling for Cygwin p4 version.
